title: Kusanagi Nene — Animal Cotton Candy♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Your School Festival is coming up, right? Tsukasa's class is doing a play, but what about your class?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, uh... We're running a cotton candy stall.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It would be fun if it didn't involve dealing with customers... I wish we picked something easier.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Sigh... I'm not looking forward to practicing how to make cotton candy tomorrow either. Maybe I can just skip it...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
We're going to split into two groups.
Girls over here please!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I couldn't come up with a good excuse and now I'm stuck here...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: We'll start by making bear-shaped cotton candy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, that's right... It's not just regular cotton candy, but animal-shaped cotton candy.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The example in the book looks really cute, but can I really make something like this?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I... I did it?! Sticking to the instructions really helped.)

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's so cute!
Our customers are gonna love it!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: Whoa! Was Toya born to make cotton candy?! This is perfect!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The boys are getting all excited too.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Whoa! Aoyagi's really good at this.
We can't let them outdo us!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Phew! That was fun!
I think I'm getting the hang of it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah. It takes a while to make even just one.
We might have to make a bunch in advance.

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: That sounds good. Having lots of different ones on display should attract more customers too.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They all seem like they're having fun...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This atmosphere has the same feel as when we're preparing our shows...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Yeah, that's a good idea! I mean, who can resist trying one of these adorable cotton candy creatures?

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: And screwing up on purpose too!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They care so much about our stall being successful. I feel like I should make a bit of an effort too.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I-Is something wrong?
You look pale. Are you okay...?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Um... One of our cotton candy machines...! It's busted...!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh no... And we were just about to get started making the candy!)

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: I have an idea! Let's ask Kamishiro and see if he can fix it! He's the guy that makes robots and drones, right?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yes...! That should be easy for Rui!)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: I-I don't want to be the one to ask him. He's a second year, and I heard he's a creep who uses his drones to spy on other students!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Let's just start making the candy with the other machine. Otherwise, we won't have anything ready in time!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line: We can't make enough with just one machine!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Wow, you're good at it, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
Yeah, it's so cute!
Our customers are gonna love it!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I, um... I know Kamishiro, so...!
I'll go ask him if he can help!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There. All done.
It won't give you any more trouble.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
You're welcome. But I must leave you now.
Tsukasa wanted to see me too.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Thanks for getting Rui to repair the cotton candy machine for us! We can open our stall now!

rows.Speaker: Classmate C
rows.Line:
We can't thank you enough, Kusanagi!
You're Class 1-B's savior!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-It's not a big deal... It was Kamishiro who fixed the machine anyway. I just called him here...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was looking forward to running this stall with everyone too so...)

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Alright, guys! Let's open for business!
